thread:
ana: @here Quick announcement — we're planning a Jira projects consolidation next month (Mar 15–16 window). Goal: reduce active projects from 12 -> 5, standardize permission schemes, and migrate board filters to the new org-level boards. This will affect engineering, product, and support project spaces. Please read and react if your team has blockers.

mike: thanks for the heads up. is there an outage/downtime expected for Jira during the migration window?

ana: ana: Not full outage — read-only for ~30m during the final sync. We'll keep the migration in stages: export -> dry-run on staging -> final cutover. Ops will post the exact timeline next week.

sophia: Can you share the mapping of old projects -> new projects? Some teams have custom workflows we can't lose.

ana: posted spreadsheet: https://redwood-internal/ops/jira-consolidation-mapping (edit permissions to project leads). Mapping includes workflow migration notes. If you have custom statuses/transitions, add them to the "workflow exceptions" tab.

kyle: what about automation rules and webhooks? Are those going to be moved automatically?

ana: automation rules will be exported and re-applied where possible. Some global rules tied to project keys will need manual touch-ups. Webhooks will be validated in staging — we'll provide a script to list webhooks per project:```curl -s -u $JIRA_USER:$JIRA_API_TOKEN "https://jira.redwood/api/3/project/{projectKey}/webhook"```

laura: tagging customer-support here — @maria @dev-support — there will be changes to ticket routing. We'll coordinate ticket queue mapping doc in the spreadsheet.

mike: permission schemes are a big one. Are we collapsing schemes or creating a new standard scheme? I don't want engineers losing access mid-sprint.

ana: we'll introduce two canonical schemes: "Eng-Standard" and "Cross-Functional". Migration plan: create schemes in staging, run a dry-migrate script that outputs a delta report, then apply during cutover. We'll keep a rollback plan. Access won't be removed until after verification.

sophia: how are we handling Jira group mappings vs Okta groups? We recently synced Okta groups to Jira — will the sync break?

ana: good question — Okta group mappings will be maintained. We'll update the Jira group memberships as part of the migration so the sync remains intact. We do need SAML/SSO admins to approve the updated group-to-permission mappings.

mike: can infra-bot run the dry-run and post the delta?

infra-bot: auto:dry-run started for projects [PROJ1, PROJ2, PROJ3] at 1767201800. Output report: https://artifacts.redwood/jenkins/jira-migration/dryrun-1767201800.csv :thumbsup:

laura: quick ask — will project keys change? some integrations (CI, webhooks) reference keys in code.

ana: we'll preserve project keys where possible. If a key must change, we'll add an alias project key and maintain HTTP redirects for the issue URLs during the transition period. We'll also publish a migration guide for integrators.

kyle: who signs off on exceptions? Some teams will need legacy workflows for a while.

ana: signoff by team leads + platform PM (me) + security. Please add exception requests to the spreadsheet by EOD Fri. We'll triage in next week's sync.

mike: can we get the runbook + rollback checklist now so teams can plan?

ana: putting runbook in the ops repo: https://git.redwood/ops/jira-consolidation/runbook.md — it includes steps, smoke tests, and rollback commands. Example rollback command in runbook:

```# rollback example
./jira-migrate --target staging --undo --from snapshot-1767201600
```

sophia: thanks — adding our workflow exceptions. Also, can we schedule a 30min pre-cutover office hour for teams to ask last-minute Qs?

ana: yep. I'll set up an office hour next Wed 11am PT. Calendar invite coming.

laura: noted. @here please review the mapping and flag any blocking automation by Thursday.

mike: ack. will coordinate with CI owners to validate webhooks and integrations.

infra-bot: reminder: backup job scheduled 1767202800. Snapshot: jira-snapshot-1767202700 stored in s3://redwood-jira-backups/.

ana: thanks all. We'll post an updated timeline and checklist after the dry-run results. Please ping me directly for urgent issues. :rocket:
